review_type: Independent visual comparison of local source photographs and rendered model; not measured survey or pipe-topology validation
passed_checks: Left solid pale stone pier and right dark horizontal-louver pier are visibly asymmetric, rather than duplicated copies.
Right pier preserves the visible pale upper band and projecting stone cap; unknown rear face is neutral and disclosed.
Entrance barriers now read as two compound returning tube groups, not four independently grounded ordinary U-shaped hoops.
The front broad arches, rear narrow higher returns, and intermediate lower bends are represented as a silhouette approximation.
One low transverse silver barrier with a yellow middle sleeve is present on the front-right side.
Cropped threshold and paving form a bounded entrance-core model; background buildings, road, trees, bicycle racks, fences and lamps are excluded.
The reviewed renders are readable and visibly show the intended scope; no apparent missing pier or low barrier.
limitations_retained: Source photograph is not sufficient to certify how overlapping tubular segments connect or all ground-contact locations; model connections and hidden feet remain approximations.
Four upper arc silhouettes must not be presented as proof of four separate standard U-shaped barriers.
Left pier is cropped in the source: complete width, depth, rear geometry, pier separation, barrier depth and all model dimensions are unmeasured estimates.
Louver count, material appearance, paving pattern and thickened pipe diameter are simplified, not exact photogrammetric reconstructions.
The source image dates are unknown; no claim of current 2026 condition is supported.
This visual result does not verify printability, minimum wall thickness, support-free printing or real-world construction topology.
scope_of_pass: Acceptable only as the documented bounded historical-photo entrance-core approximation. Not a complete West Gate reconstruction or independent campus building.
